title: A sprint whose items share only doc touches still runs its code items in parallel
goal: the kb-sprint plan step moves the kb/_self doc edits that most of a sprint's items share (tools.md, code.md) into one docs task at the end, or names how land resolves doc-only overlaps, so items whose code touches do not meet run in parallel

run: import sys; t = open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md').read(); sys.exit(0 if 'docs task' in t else 1)

notes: SP-czs3jk57 close: four of six work items shared kb/_self/tools.md and kb/_self/code.md and nothing else, so they ran one after another (about two hours of serial worker time) although their code touches did not overlap.
